# Permissions and roles

Every call to the Plux Server names the permission it needs, and a principal that does not hold it is refused (`SEC-102`). This page lists the permission catalogue and the predefined roles (`GOV-002`, [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-roles-permissions-and-scoping.md)). It is generated from `backend/internal/auth/permissions.json` and `backend/internal/auth/roles.json`.

## Permissions

**Risk** is the damage a misused permission can do. **Step-up** permissions are usable only in a session that presented a second factor (`SEC-100`, `SEC-103`). **Scope** is the narrowest scope a permission can be granted at: `organization` permissions apply across the organisation only; `app` permissions can also be granted on one app; `environment` permissions can also be granted on one environment of an app and written `<permission>:<environment>`, for example `release.publish:production` (`GOV-003`). **Read-only** permissions change nothing.

The catalogue is grouped as area, feature, action (`GOV-002`). A restriction policy names a permission or one of the wildcards `*`, `<area>.*` and `<area>.<feature>.*` (`GOV-006`, [ADR-0086](../adr/0086-restriction-policies-and-effective-permissions.md)).

## Predefined roles

- **owner** — May do everything, including managing members, roles, identity providers, keys and the licence.
- **admin** — May do everything except manage members and keys.
- **release-manager** — May publish, promote and roll back releases, run rollouts and flags, and use the kill switch and break-glass; may not edit code.
- **developer** — May edit plugins, deploy functions outside production and publish.
- **designer** — May edit plugins, pages and translations; may not publish.
- **translator** — May read and edit translations, and nothing else.
- **reviewer** — May read everything an approver needs and approve or reject changes.
- **compliance-officer** — May read the audit log and reconstructions, manage approval policies and change freezes, handle data-subject requests and produce compliance reports.
- **auditor** — Read-only access to everything, including the audit log, reconstructions and compliance reports.
- **viewer** — May read.

A role holds exactly the permissions marked below; there is no inheritance.
